prompt: Create a vertical realistic social media ad photo about AI image realism testing. Show a young adult white man with short blond hair, blue eyes, light stubble, and a slight confident smile, wearing a plain black T-shirt in a modern neutral-toned apartment or studio kitchen. He is seated behind an open laptop on a table and holds a small black handheld microphone with a gray furry windscreen near his chest, as if presenting a test result. The laptop screen is clearly visible and displays a side-by-side comparison with exactly 2 portrait panels of the same man holding a white cylindrical product: the left panel looks slightly soft, waxy, and blurry and is labeled “4K” in bold white text at the bottom; the right panel looks sharper and more natural and is labeled “2K + HIGH” in bold white text at the bottom. Add a large bold all-caps white headline at the top reading REALISM TEST. Use natural window light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, muted beige-gray walls, shelves with minimal decor and a small plant in the background, clean creator-testimonial composition, vertical 9:16 framing, high-end UGC ad aesthetic. Keep all text legible, use only the headline and the two laptop labels, no logos, no watermark, no extra UI elements.

promptZh: 制作一张关于 AI 图像真实感测试的竖屏真实社交媒体广告照片。画面中是一位年轻的白人男性，留着金色短发，蓝色眼睛，留着淡淡的胡茬，带着自信的微笑，身穿纯黑色 T 恤，身处现代简约风格的公寓或工作室厨房中。他坐在桌前，面前放着一台打开的笔记本电脑，胸前拿着一个带有灰色毛绒防风罩的小型黑色手持麦克风，仿佛正在展示测试结果。笔记本电脑屏幕清晰可见，显示着并排对比图，包含 2 个完全相同的男性肖像面板，手中拿着一个白色圆柱形产品：左侧面板看起来略显柔和、有蜡质感且模糊，底部用粗体白色文字标注为“4K”；右侧面板看起来更清晰、更自然，底部用粗体白色文字标注为“2K + HIGH”。在顶部添加一个醒目的大号粗体全大写白色标题，内容为 REALISM TEST。使用自然的窗光，浅景深，真实的皮肤纹理，柔和的米灰色墙壁，背景中有带有极简装饰的搁板和一株小植物，采用干净的创作者证言式构图，9:16 竖屏比例，高端 UGC 广告美学。确保所有文字清晰可辨，仅使用标题和两个笔记本电脑标签，不要包含任何标志、水印或额外的 UI 元素。
